What

Add `/economics` with a scroll-drawn reward schedule, the recorded head marker, exact supply and payment calculators and expandable fee comparisons. Add the economics-only suite evidence reader and make the tool available in the grid.

## Why

Readers can follow the difference between the pinned target and indexed payments. Every observation retains its date and source. Missing issuance, validator receipts and audit payouts stay UNOBSERVABLE. Scenario calculations are labelled and integer dust stays visible.

## Checks

- Fresh-clone full gate passed. The revised page passed the production build and web checks. Final workspace gate also passed.
- Browser checks at 390 px and 1440 px passed calculators, invalid inputs, dust handling, filters, expansion, raw download, copy and shared navigation. No overflow, page errors or external browser requests were observed.
- Reduced-motion checks passed at both widths. Scroll dash offsets measured 1, 0.432836 and 0. Disclosure frames and desktop/mobile screenshots are in shots/.
- Local Lighthouse mobile: performance 99, accessibility 95 and CLS 0. See LIGHTHOUSE.json. Its accessibility finding is the shared shell's unnamed mobile search button.
- Model tests and mutation evidence are in the preceding core PR #47. This page uses that checked library.
- No deployed performance, chain finality, runtime storage proof, circulating supply, individual reward or inference correctness was verified.

What

Adds the /staking stake builder, quoted slashing walkthrough and recorded stake comparison. The suite registry now links the alpha page and its dated evidence.

## Why

Operators can see how capacity changes the documented bond and inspect what each offence can lose. Unknown rates and missing calibration remain explicit. The page separates indexed balances from current runtime eligibility.

## Checks

25 package tests pass and one optional live test skips. Fresh-clone and final worktree gates pass install, check, build and Java. The README quick start was exercised. See FRESH-GATE.log, QUICKSTART.log and gate-site.log.

Production Chromium checks pass at 390 px and 1440 px with normal and reduced motion. Inputs, loss scenarios, filters, disclosures, copy and shared navigation work. No overflow, page errors or external browser requests were observed. Four frames show the bond bars changing. See BROWSER.json, SCROLL.json and shots/.

Mobile Lighthouse at 2026-11-06T01:08:41.609Z: performance 99, accessibility 95 and CLS 0. Tool content has no axe violations. The new shared mobile search trigger lacks an accessible name; that shell finding is recorded for the orchestrator in SHELL-FINDING.md. See LIGHTHOUSE.json.

This does not verify runtime storage, current calibration leases, finality, withdrawals or actual slashable balances. Network #75 remains unverifiable from the available fields.

What

Add /sessions with a recorded lifecycle diagram, state filters, channel tracing, evidence drawers and recorder sample counts. Register the page as alpha and add its sourced suite metric.

## Why

Separate a forced claim from a payout. Trace a channel only between its reported opening and latest state. Inspect the exact fields, copy the channel ID and open the verifier or challenger.

## Checks

- Recorded population: 624 channels, 347 settlement rows and 10 forced claims awaiting finalisation. Source and capture time remain visible.
- Package check: 23 passing tests and one opt-in live skip. Replacing latest states with finalised caused a targeted test failure. Restoration passed. See MUTATION-RED.log and MUTATION-GREEN.log.
- Desktop 1440 px, mobile 390 px and reduced-motion checks passed filtering, tracing, drawer focus return, downloads and shared navigation. No page errors, overflow or external browser requests were observed. See BROWSER.json and shots.
- Final local Lighthouse mobile measured performance 100, accessibility 95, CLS 0 and LCP 1207.3693 ms. The accessibility finding is the shared header's unnamed find button. See LIGHTHOUSE.json.
- Exact README commands passed in the fresh clone. Instrumented CLI replay recorded zero fetch calls. Full final gates are recorded in FRESH-GATE.log and gate-site.log.

This classifies public indexer reports. It does not verify finality, inference, hardware, challenge standing or payout amounts. Historical rows are recorder settlement samples, not full channel history. No deployment was performed.
